g.title: G
g.text: PRETRAINING | Actual forward heads and parameter sharing
Same [ID] = same parameter object; different IDs = independent parameters

g.title: cluster_backbone
g.text: A. Image and text inputs / shared backbone

g.title: cluster_quality
g.text: B. Quality projection space | shared across three views

g.title: cluster_semantic
g.text: C. Semantic projection heads | exact upstream routes

g.title: cluster_mos
g.text: D. Clean-view MOS scoring | does NOT pass through PQ

g.title: cluster_local
g.text: E. Region / word feedback | shared heads, distinct upstream features

g.title: lp
g.text: Clean map supplies MOS / region paths

g.title: qcp
g.text: Output computed, NOT used by Anchor/CE

g.title: simg
g.text: zc for main I-P / I-A losses

g.title: auxin
g.text: concat(zc, weighted Pq evidence, abs difference)

g.title: mix
g.text: Mix global Q and patch Q

g.title: ascore
g.text: Same Align scoring path as downstream

g.title: note
g.text: ACTIVE CONFIG: Quality Adapter OFF in pretraining; separate_quality_projection=True.
MOS heads do not directly train PQ; Anchor/CE do. Shared backbone receives both tasks.
PQ -> downstream QA is INITIALIZATION, not runtime sharing. PI/PT and predictors not transferred.
Existing checkpoint PCGrad ON. Legacy Final score computed but not supervised.
